title: Cancel an order placed by mistake

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, thank you for calling, my name is Jordan. What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hi, I placed an order this morning by mistake and I need to cancel it before it ships. I am a bit worried it is too late.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I understand, let me take a look straight away. Could you give me the order number?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, it is order two zero nine one.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Good news, the order has not been packed yet, so I have cancelled it for you. There is no cancellation fee.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Okay, thank you. That is a relief.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The payment will be returned to your card within two days. Anything else today?
